issue.title: popup的label显示不正常
issue.body:
### 摘要 / Summary

目前的popup的label只能显示一个字或字母,无法完整显示定义的label

### 重现步骤 / Steps to Reproduce

1. 默认主题
2. 长按回车键盘, 应该显示  "设置", "wiki" ,但实际只显示 "设", "w"
```
- {click: Return, label_symbol: "wiki", popup: ["TrimeWiki", "Settings"], composing: Return1, swipe_up: Escape, width: 15, key_back_color: benter, key_text_color: tenter}
```

3. 尝试过修改popup的宽度,和字的大小,还是无法完整显示
```
  popup_width: 58 #按键提示宽度
  popup_text_size: 12 #按键提示字号
```



### 预期行为 / Expected Behavior

希望能完整显示popup中的label

upstream.source: Fresh gh api commits/develop agrees with local origin/develop and root fetch

correction: Issue2033 concerns long-press key popup action labels. PopupCandidates/PagedCandidatesUi are a different feature and not the root-cause path.

duplicate_check.result: No current duplicate found in fresh bounded title/body searches and open PR inspection. Adjacent2195/2192/2183 changed-file lists contain neither ime/popup files nor AutoScaleTextView. Not an exhaustive guarantee against unpublished work or search indexing lag.

confirmed_root_cause.path: PopupDelegate.reallyShowKeyboard -> PopupKeyboardUi.labels.map -> theme.resolveAction(label).getLabel(KeyboardWindow.currentKeyboard) -> first code point -> PopupKeyUi -> AutoScaleTextView
confirmed_root_cause.behavior: Except a one-character ASCII shortcut and full icon tokens, every resolved action label is deliberately replaced by String(Character.toChars(label.codePointAt(0))). This occurs before text measurement; width/font settings cannot recover deleted characters.
confirmed_root_cause.actual_asset: tongwenfeng default Return has popup TrimeWiki/Settings. Presets label them Wiki and 设置. Upstream code necessarily yields W and 设 given the resolved labels.
confirmed_root_cause.historical_vs_current: The issue report is historical, but the exact destructive truncation remains in latest7fed source and the referenced labels remain shipped. No current Android visual reproduction is claimed by this read-only investigation.
confirmed_root_cause.existing_renderer: PopupKeyUi uses AutoScaleTextView.Mode.Proportional and draws text, so preserve full resolved label and let existing measurement/scale logic fit it. Icon branch already routes ic@ tokens to ImageView.

single_behavior_recommendation.scope: Only preserve the complete resolved action label in PopupKeyboardUi. Keep ASCII shortcut, action resolution, original trigger token, icon routing, popup dimensions, row/column layout and ordinary key preview behavior unchanged.
single_behavior_recommendation.minimal_change: Remove first-code-point truncation around getLabel; no new text fitter, callback layer or helper-only production abstraction is required.
do_not_bundle: Keyboard key-preview first-character policy in KeyView.showPopupPreview

separate_capacity_finding.formula: rowCount=ceil(n/5); columnCount=round(n/rowCount); rowCount*columnCount can be less than n. keyOrders can never reference the remaining final indices.
separate_capacity_finding.proof_limit: Read-only evaluation of source formula, not Android gesture or rendered-capacity acceptance. Record for a separate behavior fix.

Android_public_API_feasibility.why: KeyboardWindow.currentKeyboard is public lateinit and can be assigned a public Keyboard(selfConfig=null), but KeyAction.getLabel always enters adjustCase, which reads RimeDaemon.getFirstSessionOrNull()!! and session.run{statusCached}, even for multi-character explicit preset labels. RimeDaemon object initialization also begins realRime message collection; createSession starts the real backend.
Android_public_API_feasibility.narrow_real_Rime_path: Use a dedicated public RimeDaemon.createSession name, wait runOnReady withTimeout, assign public currentKeyboard, parse bundled theme with real ThemeYaml/ThemeDslExpander and activate ColorManager scope, then construct real PopupKeyboardUi with original action tokens. This uses real JNI/Rime but need not launch full IME Activity/service.
Android_public_API_feasibility.cleanup_limit: destroySession can synchronously finalize native engine; coroutine timeout alone cannot guarantee that blocking native call returns. Overall instrumentation watchdog and root VM cleanup must cover total deadline, and all native maintenance/config/encoding warnings remain evidence.
Android_public_API_feasibility.insufficient_alternative: An ASCII-only outer PopupKeyboardUi allows direct inner PopupKeyUi("设置") rendering without Rime, but bypasses action-label resolution/truncation and cannot alone demonstrate issue2033 regression.

source_and_fixture: Match baseline and fixed source/asset/APK hashes; use exactly original TrimeWiki/Settings tokens and actual resolved labels.
Use actual PopupKeyboardUi construction, recursively inspect public TextView.text/ImageView state, measure/layout/draw real AutoScale children, save synthetic UI bitmap evidence.
Default38dp, narrow24dp and larger popupTextSize should retain complete label text and nonempty bounded rendering. Do not equate this object render with full IME/system touch acceptance.
selection: Move focus via public onChangeFocus using container-local coordinates and call onTrigger; check original TrimeWiki/Settings token unchanged. Do not execute Settings/browser activities.

Add explicitly declared preset fixtures for single ASCII, multi-CJK, supplementary/combining/ZWJ labels and ic@ icon; preserve empty/icon semantics. All go through actual full action resolution, not a surrogate string mapper.
baseline_and_fixed: Baseline must produce a captured expected label assertion failure with no uncaught product FATAL; fixed must satisfy all label/render/token controls.
Inspect runtime stage and target APK identity; an early session/parser/fixture failure is a harness/precondition failure, not reproduction.
RimeReady/native startup/teardown, preference restoration, selected default IME and artifact cleanup must be explicitly reported. No no-JNI/full-keyboard/TalkBack claim.

actions: Fresh read-only GH CLI requests, git/source inspection and arithmetic model only; no production edit, build, ADB, emulator or PR creation. Wrote investigation artifacts only.
applicable_AGENTS: No applicable AGENTS in public/worktree Kotlin source ancestors; only unrelated native/vendor AGENTS exist.
next_work: Root selected full action labels only. Independent ignored Android helper requested separately, with real public Rime session and explicit object/render scope.
